name: Notification System Dispatch Mail
description: A 'mail' dispatcher plugin for notification_system_dispatch that sends a user's notifications by email, using admin-configured Twig subject and body templates rendered via hook_mail.
project_description: The mail channel for notification_system_dispatch. It registers a 'mail' notification_system_dispatcher plugin whose dispatch() sends a user's notifications to their account email via the Drupal mail system. The email subject and body are produced by admin-configured Twig templates (a 'notifications' variable exposes each notification's title, body, timestamp and link), rendered in hook_mail. It integrates with the site's mail configuration and optionally sets an HTML content type when the swiftmailer module is present. The mail dispatcher's settings appear inside the notification_system_dispatch settings form and are config-translatable.
